definitions.explanation: A separately ventilated room set aside for smoking inside an otherwise smoke-free building. Standard in Japanese offices, airports, stations, and hotels since indoor smoking restrictions tightened in 2020.

examples.japanese: {喫煙室|きつえんしつ}はどこですか。
たばこは{喫煙室|きつえんしつ}でお{吸|す}いください。
examples.english: Please smoke in the smoking room.

examples.japanese: この{建物|たてもの}の{喫煙室|きつえんしつ}は{三階|さんがい}にあります。
examples.english: The smoking room in this building is on the third floor.

examples.japanese: {法改正|ほうかいせい}で、{多|おお}くの{飲食店|いんしょくてん}が{喫煙室|きつえんしつ}を{設|もう}けるか{全面禁煙|ぜんめんきんえん}にするかを{選|えら}んだ。
examples.english: With the change in the law, many restaurants chose between installing a smoking room and going completely smoke-free.

notes:
Formed from {喫煙|きつえん} (smoking) + {室|しつ} (room). Appears on signage everywhere in Japan, so it is worth recognizing at a glance.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {喫煙室|きつえんしつ}を{利用|りよう}する: to use the smoking room
- {喫煙室|きつえんしつ}を{設|もう}ける: to install a smoking room
- {分煙|ぶんえん}のための{喫煙室|きつえんしつ}: a smoking room for separating smokers and non-smokers

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {喫煙所|きつえんじょ}: smoking area — may be outdoors or merely partitioned, not necessarily a room
- {禁煙|きんえん}: no smoking; quitting smoking — the sign you see far more often
- {分煙|ぶんえん}: segregation of smoking and non-smoking areas
